blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — First Philippine Holdings Corp. (FPH) will continue repurchasing its shares as the management believes the company remains significantly undervalued. Francis Giles Puno, president and chief operating officer of FPH, said the Lopez-led conglomerate had bought back 185 million shares since launching the program in 2010.
